basic_info.name: Richa Global Exports Pvt. Ltd.
basic_info.description: RICHA GLOBAL EXPORTS PRIVATE LIMITED.Established in 1977, Richa Global has grown into a recognized leader in the international garment industry. Over the past forty years, we have positioned our company as a global organization with a distinctive identity as a dominant presence in the ready made garment export sector with large scale production capacity in woven, knitted and leather garments and accessories.Richa Global is equipped with 16 fully integrated manufacturing units in New Delhi, NCR (National Capitol Region) and Bangalore and has become a favored supplier of high fashion garments to leading customers across the world. Our current US clients include Ann Taylor, Loft, J.Jill, Talbots, Hanna Andersson, American Eagle, Belk Stores, Chicos, J.Crew & Madewell.  In Europe we work with Liu.Jo Jeans, Superdry, Esprit, Sainsbury’s, Tory Burch, Hugo Boss, Michael Kors, & Mark & Spencer.Combining the latest technologies with a core roster of competent professionals, Richa Global is setting new benchmarks in the global garment industry.  With 12,000 well-trained employees and $ 150 million USD turnover annually in the financial year 2019-20, Richa Global Group upholds the highest standards on a large scale. We leave no stone unturned to achieve the best at all levels of our operations and we work closely with our retail partners to understand their needs and deliver quality products in a timely fashion all over the world.Richa Global is proud to be at the forefront of the industry in complying with governmental laws and regulations while meeting our customer’s requirements.  We are a hi-tech, customer-friendly, eco-responsive corporate citizen that is helping to shape a better tomorrow for everyone.

basic_info.name: Hari Krishna Exports Pvt. Ltd.
basic_info.description: At Hari Krishna Exports, we are a global leader in the natural diamond industry, powered by a purpose that goes beyond our stones. Since our founding in 1992, we have been built on three core values: Family, Faith, and Philanthropy.We believe that our people, from our skilled artisans in Surat to our global partners, are the true heart of our business. We are a family of over 9,000 members, united by a shared faith in the enduring value of natural diamonds and a steadfast commitment to giving back through our philanthropic arm, Dholakia Foundation.This philosophy is reflected in every facet of our operations. We lead the industry in ethical sourcing and sustainable practices, proudly operating our facilities on 100% renewable solar energy. Our commitment to innovation is matched by our dedication to empowering communities, creating opportunities, and making a lasting positive impact.Our diamonds go beyond just a symbol of everlasting love; they are a reflection of our dedication to our people, our planet, and the positive change we can create together. We believe that true success is measured not only by the sparkle of our diamonds but also by the strength of our values.

basic_info.name: Modelama Exports Pvt Ltd
basic_info.description: Modelama Group, headquartered in Gurgaon, stands as a beacon of innovation and excellence in the fashion and garment industry. With a rich legacy spanning decades, the group has earned a reputation for delivering top-quality products and services to clients worldwide. At the heart of our success lies a team of passionate individuals who drive our vision forward with creativity, dedication, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.In addition to its core garment manufacturing operations, Modelama Group has diversified its portfolio to include ventures in various sectors. This expansion encompasses real estate investments, with ownership of malls and commercial properties, as well as ventures in luxury jewellery. Furthermore, the group has established a presence in the automotive industry, with a chain of dealership and service centres for four-wheelers across India.Backed by sound technical expertise and efficiency, the company in just over four decades of its existence has created several benchmarks of excellence in woven garment market.From a modest beginning with 50 indigenous sewing machines in a workspace of 4,000 sq. feet in New Delhi, India generating turn-over of USD 0.5 million, Modelama’s infrastructure, propelled by landmarks in innovation, creativity and an unwavering commitment to quality now spreads across 800,000 sq. feet in and around Delhi with in the range of annual US $85-90 millions.

basic_info.name: D'Decor Exports Pvt Ltd
basic_info.description: D'Decor Exports Pvt. Ltd. is the world's largest manufacturer and exporter of curtains and upholstery fabrics.Since the last 15 years, our mission is to make homes fashionable around the world with our exquisite product offerings. We export home textile fabrics to over 65 countries worldwide & our customers include some of the largest and leading global brands. The design department at D’Decor works in sync with Italian design houses, thus ensuring that the design output is in sync with international color & fashion trends in home furnishings. We have copyright ownership over more than 10,000 designs. Each of our designs are patented and finalized only after extensive sampling. As a company, D'Decor has accomplished many firsts in the Indian furnishing fabric business. We were the first to introduce water-repellent fabric, flame-retardant fabrics and also to have the first robotic warehouse in India. 4 state-of-the-art manufacturing plants situated at Tarapur, near Mumbai, output at our plant exceeds a 100, 000 metres a day. At any given point of time, D'Decor's supply chain is capable of delivering more than 200,000 SKUs. These are chosen from a large spectrum of products comprising furnishing fabric, embroidered fabric, yarn, ready-mades, velvets and wallpapers. D'Decor is a proud employer with a family of more than 2200 committed employees. After proving our excellence in the international market, we are now focused on the Indian growth story. In the year 2008, we re-launched ourselves as D'Decor - a premium home furnishings brand in a new avatar. In India, we are endorsed by none other than Bollywood superstar Shahrukh Khan and his beautiful wife, Gauri Khan.
